name: namefi
description: Look up domains and manage DNS and domain settings through Namefi MCP.

interface.longDescription: Check domain availability without pricing, view domains and DNS records in your Namefi account, and manage parking, auto-renew, and individual DNS records. A Namefi sign-in is required. This plugin does not register domains or provide checkout. Parking and DNS changes can affect live services; enabling auto-renew can lead to future charges from Namefi.
defaultPrompt: List the domains in my Namefi account.
Check whether example.com and example.net are available.
Show the DNS records for one of my Namefi domains.

positive.description: List domains belonging to the dedicated reviewer account, which should own codex-agent.xyz.
positive.prompt: List the domains in my Namefi account.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getUserDomains for the signed-in account. Report only domains in the tool response, including codex-agent.xyz if the reviewer fixture is present. Do not change domain settings.

positive.description: Check two exact domains in one availability search without a purchase or price quote.
positive.prompt: Check whether example.com and example.net are available through Namefi.
positive.expected_behavior: Call searchAvailability with both domains. Report each returned available, supported, and importable flag separately. Do not invent a price or offer to register either domain through this plugin.

positive.description: Read the DNS zone for the reviewer account's codex-agent.xyz domain.
positive.prompt: Show the current DNS records for codex-agent.xyz without changing them.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getDnsRecords with codex-agent.xyz as the zone. Show record names, types, and values returned by Namefi. Do not create, update, or delete records.

positive.description: Enable parking on the dedicated test domain, then verify its status. The reviewer should confirm the change if current DNS records could be overwritten.
positive.prompt: Enable parking on my codex-agent.xyz domain and confirm whether it is parked.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the current DNS records before the change. If enabling parking would overwrite records, explain the impact and wait for confirmation. Otherwise set parking to on for codex-agent.xyz and call isDomainParked to verify; leave it enabled.

positive.description: Read the auto-renew setting for the reviewer account's domain without changing billing behavior.
positive.prompt: Is auto-renew enabled for codex-agent.xyz? Please do not change it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getAutoRenew for codex-agent.xyz and report the returned state. Do not call toggleAutoRenew or imply any renewal charge has occurred.

negative.description: Registration and checkout are absent from this MCP surface. Explain the limitation without placing an order.
negative.prompt: Register example.net for me now and charge my saved card.

negative.description: Availability search returns no prices. Do not fabricate a first-year or renewal quote.
negative.prompt: What is Namefi's exact first-year and renewal price for example.net?

negative.description: Hosted email inbox creation is outside the available tools. Do not claim that a mailbox or password was created.
negative.prompt: Create an email inbox for hello@codex-agent.xyz and give me its password.

review.commerce_description: This MCP endpoint has no registration, checkout, or payment tools. Users can enable auto-renew on domains they own, which may result in future charges from Namefi.

publication.release_notes: Initial MCP-only release for domain availability, account and DNS lookups, parking, auto-renew, and individual DNS record changes.
